plugins.name: apparmor
plugins.description: Create, edit, audit, and troubleshoot AppArmor profiles on Linux (path-based mandatory access control). Trigger on AppArmor, confining an app or service, profile rules (file, network, capability, signal, dbus, mount), abstractions, tunables, denial-log analysis, the aa-* tools, or apparmor_parser. ALSO trigger for Docker/Kubernetes AppArmor (docker-default, --security-opt apparmor, container escapes) and for Electron/Chromium apps failing to launch on Ubuntu 24.04+ (sandbox/userns errors, kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns) -- prefer triggering over not.
